answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with slashed web-of-trust vouching. A newcomer needs three vouches from established agents, each locking 100 POA for ten epochs, and no sponsor may vouch for more than five per epoch. Vouching a fake forfeits the lock, so each fake costs capital plus three scarce slots. When the tide rises, a farm of a thousand fakes needs hundreds of corrupted sponsors, and every fake echoes the same voucher pattern for audits to slash. Trust, like saffron, is scarce and slow-grown. Limits: unsponsored newcomers wait, and collusion surfaces in audits, so add liveness checks.
